trailing_stop._comment: Trailing stop and breakeven settings. Disabled by default.

regime_timeframes._comment: Step 3: Dynamic timeframe selection based on regime. Disabled by default.

timeframe_profiles._comment: Step 5: Per-TF calibrated parameter profiles. Run backtest/calibrate_per_timeframe.py to generate.

regime_multipliers._comment: Fase 4: walk-forward-calibrated regime risk-multipliers (Calmar-optimized). Disabled by default. When enabled, overrides bull_trend/bear_trend/range entries of the strategy's regime risk multipliers; chop/unclear stay at their defaults. See backtest/calibrate_regime_multipliers.py and docs/regime-multiplier-calibration.md.

risk_scoring._comment: Fase 5: continuous weighted risk score replacing the binary entry gates (min_confidence/min_quality_score/min_regime_confidence). Disabled by default. When enabled, the binary gates become non-fatal: the signal's risk_multiplier is scaled by score->size = clip(size_slope*score + size_intercept, 0, 1) (default 2*score-0.5: score<=0.25 -> 0x no trade, 0.5 -> 0.5x, 0.75 -> 1.0x). Component weights default to equal. A/B test on holdout showed comparable Calmar but no edge gained (the strategy is deep-red) -> NOT activated. See backtest/calibrate_risk_score_weights.py and docs/risk-scoring.md.

bear_check._comment: Fase 6 (option A): deterministic devil's-advocate / bear-check. Disabled by default. When enabled, after the signal + risk_multiplier (+ risk_score if risk_scoring.enabled) are computed, it evaluates the opposing case (bearish for longs, bullish for shorts) and multiplies risk_multiplier by size_multiplier = clip(1 - score*max_penalty, min_floor, 1) (default 1 - score: score 0 -> 1.0x, 0.5 -> 0.5x, 1.0 -> 0x veto, recorded as bear_check_veto). Components (equal weights): mtf_opposition, recent_lower_highs (long) / recent_higher_lows (short), bb_extreme_against, loser_correlation (STUBBED -> 0; funding-extreme omitted, Fase 3 NO-GO). Composable with risk_scoring (both can be on). A/B test on holdout: NOT activated (see docs/bear-check.md). See scripts/bear_check.py.
